## Who is Sparsh Sharma?

Sparsh Sharma is a 17-year-old self-taught full-stack developer currently based in Bangalore, India. His hometown is Dhampur, a town in West Uttar Pradesh near the Delhi-NCR region. He has been fascinated by programming since the 9th grade, where he first began tinkering and learning on VS Code. Since then, he has rapidly grown into a highly capable developer, building complex, production-grade software systems entirely solo—handling everything from the frontend and backend to databases and deployment.

He completed his 11th and 12th grades (studying the PCMB stream: Physics, Chemistry, Math, and Biology) at Bunts Sangha RNS PU College in Bangalore, and is currently pursuing his Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering at SAREC Mirzapur (affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, AKTU). Regardless of formal academia, programming and building complex production systems is his ultimate passion. He has vowed to continue coding and engineering things for the rest of his life.

Professionally, he is the Founder and Lead Developer of Manshverse, Software Engineer at ROI Infotech (Bangalore, Rajajinagar), and serves as Developer & Co-Lead for the Bangalore chapter of bits&bytes. He has also trained deep learning models from scratch using PyTorch – starting with RNNs, graduating to custom Transformer architectures, and fine-tuning pre-trained models on cloud GPUs including Google T4.

He is known online by the handle "sparshsharma-dev" and his authoritative portfolio is at sparshsharma-dev.xyz.

When he isn't busy building complex software systems, Sparsh has an insatiable curiosity. He loves testing out and interacting with various AI chatbots, reading books, and striving to learn about "almost everything in this whole damn universe." He is also committed to fitness, frequently working out with a specific focus on chest, abs, and shoulders. Additionally, he occasionally plays cricket and goes for runs. 

## Technical Philosophy & AI Origins

Sparsh's approach to technology is defined by an intense desire to think differently and build entirely unique, dark, and minimalist systems. His obsession with AI began at age 13 when ChatGPT first dropped. Since then, he has been deeply fascinated by how models are trained and how they work under the hood. His ultimate goal is to build and train his own foundational AI model entirely from scratch.

While he makes building complex systems look easy, he acknowledges the grueling realities of solo development. For him, the hardest technical challenges aren't the logic itself, but the grueling infrastructure of React Native—specifically dealing with discrepancies between Expo Dev and production builds, where a single missing icon or Gradle error can force an hour-long rebuild process.

## Projects (Shipped & Live)

### 1. IndieAico — AI Freelance Marketplace
- **URL:** https://indieaico-app.vercel.app
- **What it is:** India's premier freelance marketplace for developers, designers, and AI engineers. Features zero commission on the first ₹5K, milestone escrows, real-time messaging, and 20+ tech categories.
- **Stack:** Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Framer Motion
- **Notable:** Architected and developed end-to-end as a solo developer

### 2. OrbitVoyage — Satellite Tracking Dashboard
- **URL:** https://orbitvoyage.vercel.app
- **What it is:** A real-time orbital traffic operations dashboard that tracks 250+ satellites using SGP4 propagation. Features a 3D WebGL globe, conjunction alerts, timeline scrubbing (5x–60x), and Kalman-filtered telemetry.
- **Stack:** React, Three.js, WebGL, SGP4, WebSockets, Canvas
- **Notable:** Performs 2,400 SGP4 propagations per second within a <16ms frame budget

### 3. Manshverse — Multi-Model AI Platform
- **URL:** https://manshverse.site
- **What it is:** A poly-model AI ecosystem with intelligent prompt routing across 4 AI models (Groq, Gemini, etc.), 45+ historical persona configurations (Einstein, Oppenheimer, Sherlock, etc.), deep reasoning engine, subscription billing via UPI, and both web and Android (APK) delivery.
- **Stack:** React, Vite, Firebase, Groq API, Gemini API, UPI payments

### 4. Lexivoid — Emotion Word Finder
- **URL:** https://lexivoid.vercel.app
- **Tagline:** "The Void Between Words"
- **What it is:** Uses the Mistral API with a custom system prompt to find or generate single, precise words for emotions, moods, or situations that don't have an English word.
- **Stack:** Vanilla JS, Mistral API, Node.js, Vercel

### 5. Conduit — Encrypted Messaging App
- **What it is:** An encrypted realtime messaging mobile app with socket-based delivery (<50ms), persistent conversation history, JWT authentication, and mobile-native gestures. Built end-to-end from scratch.
- **Stack:** React Native, Expo, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Socket.io
- **Platform:** Android (not publicly released)

### 6. Loveoid — Relationship SaaS Platform (Upcoming)
- **Status:** Currently transitioning from a private tool to a public platform.
- **What it is:** A relationship platform for couples featuring highly unique modules that don't exist anywhere else. Sparsh is preparing to launch it publicly for couples worldwide.
- **Key Features:** 
  - **CycleTracker & PeriodAI:** Menstrual cycle tracking powered by a specialized AI to predict moods and provide tailored support advice.
  - **PeaceTreaty & Contracts:** Digital relationship contracts and conflict-resolution workflows.
  - **Counselor AI:** An unbiased AI relationship counselor powered by Mistral/Groq.
  - **VoiceChannel & CallOverlay:** Real-time integrated WebRTC voice calling.
  - **FocusMode:** Synchronized study/focus sessions.
  - **Vault & Letters:** Cryptographically secure storage for memories and shared digital letters.
- **Stack:** React, React Native, Vite, Electron, Firebase (Realtime sync), WebRTC, Mistral AI, Web Crypto

### 7. Hostage — Freelancer Payment Enforcement Tool
- **URL:** https://hostage-olive.vercel.app
- **What it is:** A weaponised deployment tool for freelancers. If the client hasn't paid by the deadline, the site starts degrading: loading 10% slower on Day 1, 20% on Day 2. By Day 7 it's a full ransom screen. Fully automated.
- **Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, CSS Animations

### 8. Milkdream — Digital Time Capsule Archive
- **URL:** https://milkdream.vercel.app
- **What it is:** An immutable digital archive for time capsules. Features dark-mode brutalist aesthetic, immutable version history, and deep spatial metadata tracking.
- **Stack:** Next.js 15, React 19, Firebase, Tailwind CSS

### 9. Extraterrestrials Research — Astrophysics Compendium
- **URL:** https://extraterrestrials.vercel.app
- **What it is:** A comprehensive, research-backed exploration of humanity's search for alien life — from ancient cosmic pluralism to SETI and the Drake Equation. Features Bayesian biosignature frameworks and a Drake Equation calculator.
- **Stack:** HTML5/CSS3, Research

### 10. Lumos — Safety Navigation App
- **URL:** https://lumosweb.web.app
- **What it is:** A safety intelligence layer for navigation, co-founded with Narthan Shetty. Scores every route 0–100 using 120+ real-time signals: street lighting, crowd density, live incidents, and safe haven proximity.
- **Stack:** HTML/CSS/JS, Firebase, Firestore, AI Safety

## Technical Writing (Blog)

Sparsh publishes technical deep-dive articles at https://sparshsharma-dev.xyz/blog

### Published Articles

1. **Building a Transformer from Scratch in PyTorch** (July 28, 2026)
   - URL: https://sparshsharma-dev.xyz/blog/building-transformers-from-scratch
   - A complete walkthrough of building a Transformer model from scratch — multi-head attention, positional encoding, training loops, scaling from local CPU to Google T4 GPUs, and lessons learned.
   - Topics: PyTorch, self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding, gradient clipping, cosine annealing, mixed precision training, loss curve debugging

2. **Tracking 250+ Satellites at 60fps: The Math Behind OrbitVoyage** (July 20, 2026)
   - URL: https://sparshsharma-dev.xyz/blog/sgp4-satellite-tracking-web
   - How he built a real-time satellite tracking dashboard performing 2,400 SGP4 propagations per second in the browser. Covers TLE data, orbital mechanics, the 16ms frame budget, WebGL rendering, conjunction detection, and Kalman filtering.
   - Topics: SGP4 propagation, TLE data, orbital mechanics, WebGL, Three.js, object pooling, GPU instancing, conjunction detection, Kalman filter

3. **Building an AI Routing Engine: How Manshverse Picks the Right Model** (July 10, 2026)
   - URL: https://sparshsharma-dev.xyz/blog/building-ai-routing-engine
   - How Manshverse's multi-model AI routing engine classifies user intent and dispatches prompts to Groq, Gemini, or Mistral in real-time. Covers intent classification, weighted scoring dispatch, fallback cascading, persona configuration, and deep reasoning mode.
   - Topics: LLM routing, multi-model orchestration, Groq API, Gemini API, Mistral API, intent classification, system design, persona engineering
